Each square has area \(1\), so the entire \(5\times5\) grid has area

\[
5\cdot 5=25.
\]

The unshaded portion is the upper-right triangle. Its horizontal leg spans \(4\) grid squares, and its vertical leg spans \(3\) grid squares. Thus,

\[
A_{\text{unshaded}}=\frac12(4)(3)=6.
\]

Therefore, the shaded area is

\[
25-6=19.
\]

\[
\boxed{19}
